bands.title: Advanced Analytics & Data Science for Insight-Driven Decision
Most enterprises are drowning in data But starving for decisions
bands.lead: Dashboards multiply, reports pile up, and the finance team still exports to Excel every Monday morning. The problem is not a shortage of data – it is an excess of noise, a deficit of trust, and analytics tools that serve the data team but not the decision-maker. Ignitho cuts through. We build analytics that leaders actually open, forecasts they trust, and insight workflows that run themselves

items.title: Blind spots in reporting - data without context
items.body: Dashboards built for analysts, not decision-makers. KPIs that mask critical gaps

items.title: Slow insight cycles that lag behind the business
items.body: Reports arrive too late. Teams spend more time preparing data than analysing it

items.title: Spreadsheet dependency & manual processes
items.body: Critical metrics locked in spreadsheets owned by one person

items.title: AI Models That Never Reach Production
items.body: Predictive models stay in notebooks instead of driving decisions

bands.title: What We Deliver
bands.lead: From self-service BI that your CXO actually uses to predictive models embedded in your operational workflows – our analytics practice delivers insight at the speed of the business, not the speed of the data team

items.title: Self-Service BI & Visual Dashboards
items.body: Build dashboards that decision-makers open every morning, not data teams. We design and implement self-service BI environments in Power BI, Tableau, and Looker – with governed data models, semantic layers, and role-based access that put the right numbers in front of the right people. No data analyst required to run a report

items.title: Predictive Modelling & Forecasting
items.body: Replace gut feel and spreadsheet extrapolation with statistically grounded, self-updating forecast models. We build demand forecasting, revenue projection, churn prediction, and risk scoring models – all calibrated on your actual data and designed to improve continuously

items.title: KPI Development & Performance Frameworks
items.body: Define, align, and operationalize the metrics that actually matter. We design KPI hierarchies – from board-level outcomes to operational indicators – and build systems that keep them consistent and trusted

items.title: Reporting Automation & Analytics Engineering
items.body: Eliminate the Monday morning spreadsheet panic. We automate reporting pipelines end-to-end – from extraction to delivery. Ensuring every team uses the same definition of revenue, active customer, or EBITDA

items.title: Advanced Statistical Analysis & Data Science Advisory
items.body: Hypothesis testing, A/B experiments, cohort analysis, segmentation, anomaly detection, and causal inference – delivered clearly and without black boxes

items.title: Data Platform Architecture & Consulting
items.body: Independent advisory for CDOs, CIOs, and Heads of Data Engineering to evaluate architecture, make stack decisions, and build a pragmatic roadmap
